Name: Frendship Decay Modify

[font=Arial][size=6][url=https://github.com/weizinai/StardewValleyMods/blob/main/FriendshipDecayModify/Documents/Readme.md]中文介绍[/url][/size]

[size=6]Introduce[/size]

This mod allows you to change the value of the friendship decay. [size=3]If you set it to 0, the friendship will not decay, just like the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1738]Friend Forever[/url][size=3] mod. Of course, this mod is more powerful than the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1738]Friend Forever[/url][size=3] mod, and it can also modify the decay values of gifts and trash cans.[/size]
